title: "UNAUTHENTICATED" shown as the error text: actionErrorDetail reads a flat refusal body's bare `error` code before its `message`
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① an experience defect with a named location and a measured reproduction, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7141386286). Source: fleet (out-of-scope finding 2 of the #36981 dev report 7141328651, PR #37077).

## What happens

`ui/packages/core/src/actions/actionErrorDetail.ts` (`actionErrorDetail`, line 27) returns a bare-string `error` before `message`. The REST seam's flat 401 body is `{error: 'UNAUTHENTICATED', code, message}` (`anonymous-deny.ts` `ANONYMOUS_DENY_BODY`). Against that body, the user is shown the machine code instead of the sentence.

Measured on main: the Connector connections page printed 「Could not load connector connections. UNAUTHENTICATED」. PR #37077 stops those Setup surfaces from meeting the 401 while a bearer is held. Every other `actionErrorDetail` caller that reads a flat-family refusal still shows the code.

## Expected

When the body carries a `message`, `actionErrorDetail` prefers it over a bare-string `error` code. A pin covers the flat 401 body.

## Grading

area:ux · Bug · cosmetic: an error does not speak plainly (core feature ③) · any `actionErrorDetail` caller reading a flat refusal · measured once (Connector connections page) · p2 (the UX rule) · size S.

Business reason: a user whose action is refused reads 「UNAUTHENTICATED」 instead of a sentence telling them their session ended. They don't know to sign in again.

Reader: repo:objectstack#4 (new area:ux). One small PR in `@object-ui/core` with a pin.

Dedupe: `actionErrorDetail` and `UNAUTHENTICATED user text` (open and closed) returned 12 hits. #36981 is the source. The others are closed, or are about other refusals. No duplicate.
